card.name: Text around ACE inhibitor drug names
card.fires_on: Words and punctuation right before or inside ACE inhibitor names (fosinopril, moexipril, captopril, quinapril) or the phrase ACE inhibitor, in drug label text. Also a stray blank after 'Vol.' in a journal citation.

modes.label: Inside or between ACE inhibitor names
modes.description: Commas and partial word pieces within lists or names of -pril drugs.
modes.example: Benazepril, captopril, enalapril, fosinopril, lisinopril, perindopril<<,>> quinapril, ramipril

modes.label: Linking words before ACE inhibitor
modes.description: Words like with, other, to that come just before the class name ACE inhibitor or a -pril drug.
modes.example: as with<< other>> ACE inhibitors, monitoring of white blood cell

modes.label: Journal citation volume
modes.description: The space after 'Vol.' in a journal reference.

card.writes: It leans toward word pieces like 'prote', 'substr' and 'convert', which hint at enzyme and substrate wording.
card.plain: It lights up around ACE inhibitor drug names and the words leading into them, such as lists of -pril drugs.
